description: Set up monorepo structure with pnpm workspaces, turborepo, Next.js 15 frontend app, NestJS backend app, shared packages, and all base configurations (TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, TailwindCSS, Prisma).
steps: Create root package.json with pnpm workspaces config, turbo.json for build pipeline, pnpm-workspace.yaml listing apps/* and packages/*
Create apps/web/ as a Next.js 15 App Router project with TypeScript, TailwindCSS v4, and base next.config.ts. Include src/app/layout.tsx with Inter font, metadata for SEO, and global styles.

Set up shadcn/ui in apps/web/ with the emerald/navy color theme. Create components.json and install base components: Button, Card, Input, Badge, Sheet, Dialog, Tabs, Avatar, Dropdown Menu, Skeleton, Toast.

Create apps/api/ as a NestJS project with TypeScript. Include src/main.ts with CORS, validation pipes, swagger setup. Create base modules: AppModule, AuthModule, UsersModule, VehiclesModule, BookingsModule, PaymentsModule.

Create apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma with the full database schema including all entities: User, Role, Vehicle, VehicleCategory, Booking, BookingStatus, Payment, Invoice, Penalty, MaintenanceLog, VehicleCheckpoint, Document, DriverVerification, Promo, Notification, SupportTicket. Use SQLite provider for dev compatibility.
Create packages/shared/ with shared TypeScript types, enums (UserRole, BookingStatus, PaymentStatus, VehicleType), and Zod validation schemas for common entities.
Create .env.example files for both apps with all required environment variables documented.
Create root tsconfig.json, .gitignore, .prettierrc, and ESLint configs.
Run pnpm install and verify the workspace resolves correctly. Run prisma generate to create the Prisma client.
acceptance_criteria: Running pnpm install at root succeeds without errors
Running pnpm build compiles both apps/web and apps/api successfully
Prisma client generates without errors from the schema
TypeScript compiles without errors across all packages
verification: Run pnpm install at root and confirm exit code 0
Run pnpm build and confirm both apps compile
Run npx prisma generate --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma and confirm client generation
